title: Discovery Flight Saturday
description: Take the controls with an instructor on a one-hour intro flight. No experience needed — a great first look at training at Kitsap Aviation.

title: Private Pilot Info Night
description: Walk through the path to a Private Pilot Certificate, training timeline, costs, and how to get started. Q&A with our instructors.

title: Youth Aviation Day
description: A family-friendly day on the ramp for students and parents interested in flying. Meet instructors, see the aircraft, and learn about scholarships and youth programs.
